escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a dark creative studio at night, long-exposure photograph): she stands at about 60% of the frame width, framed from the waist up, her shoulders and torso squarely facing the camera in a relaxed, natural, balanced stance. Her RIGHT arm (the one on the right side of the frame) is extended straight out to the side, away from her body, at shoulder height, elbow almost straight, palm open and facing forward, fingers gently spread, the hand perfectly SHARP and still — like a presenter revealing something. From her open hand a long continuous STREAM of thin frameless glowing screens of every real digital format — tall vertical 9:16 story screens, square 1:1 and 4:5 feed posts, wide 16:9 video frames, long horizontal web banners — all showing the SAME bold, vivid, art-directed campaign adapted to each format: saturated color-block graphics, a product close-up splashed with paint, a dancer mid-jump; any tiny text on them is too small and blurred to read — flows OUTWARD to the right, away from her, toward and past the right edge of the frame, the screens growing slightly larger and more motion-blurred as they travel, each leaving a long luminous light trail of color (vivid orange, hot magenta, deep azure-blue (#0375DB), violet and teal (#36C8BF)). The stream and its trails stay entirely to the RIGHT of her body and never cross her torso, her chest, her face or her other arm. Her other arm hangs relaxed at her side. She looks straight into the lens with a confident half-smile. Her body, face and both hands are sharp; only the flowing screens and their trails carry motion blur. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens. She wears the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard, no watch, no rings. Her head stays almost frontal, both eyes and both eyebrows visible, and stays in the middle band of the frame height, never touching the top edge. The LEFT HALF of the frame (from 0% to 50% of the width) is calm, deep dark space with only faint haze: no cards, no screens, no beams, no light and no objects there; nothing crosses the vertical center line. Hard cool rim light from behind; the colored trails light the haze. Enormous contrast, punchy, cinematic, no logos of any other brand, no readable text, no letters or numbers anywhere.
